_about: FIBO 2.0 VGL template for a texture tile (owner S7). Copy structured_prompt, write every per_image field, keep every fixed field verbatim, and send only structured_prompt to the node. The website's make-tiles.mjs then removes the wrap seam and maps the tile between its floor and ceiling token roles. Rules: art/DIRECTION.md, 'Texture tiles'.
route: Comfy Cloud Bria node api_bria_fibo2_t2i; allowed only after Comfy's written confirmation (art/LICENSES.md)

node.seed: {an integer of 1 or more; record it with the render}
node.source: get_node on Comfy Cloud, 2026-11-02, recorded in baseline/v2/art-DIRECTION.md (Sizes on the Bria node)

lessons: Batch 1's stone and parchment tiles failed: each render lit the surface with a top-to-bottom gradient and left little fine texture (website art/concepts/batch-1.md). The fixed fields below describe flat, even light and one all-over pattern for that reason.

structured_prompt.short_description: {the material in one or two sentences, such as a flat block of warm sandstone covered in fine chisel strokes and soft sand grain}
structured_prompt.background_setting: {the surface itself, filling the frame edge to edge, with the same amount of texture in every part}

lighting.direction: even light from directly in front

aesthetics.composition: flat, straight-on close-up that fills the frame edge to edge with one even, all-over pattern and the same brightness everywhere
aesthetics.color_scheme: {the material's colors in words, near its floor and ceiling roles, such as warm cream sandstone or cool grey granite}

photographic_characteristics.focus: even, sharp focus across the whole frame

structured_prompt.style_medium: stylized hand-painted texture with visible painted brush texture and soft, even shading
structured_prompt.context: a repeating surface texture for a website background, calm enough to sit behind text
